Halb- oder Ganzfeld je nach Gruppengröße: Half or full court depending on group size
Basketbälle für einen Teil der Gruppe: Basketballs for some of the players
Dribbling, Stopp, Pivot und Pass verbind: Combine dribbling, stopping, pivoting and passing.

Zwei Bälle gleichzeitig kontrollieren un: Control and pass two balls at the same time.

Die Aufgabe erst im Gehen, dann im Laufe: Perform the activity first while walking, then while running.
Auf Farbsignale reagieren und kontrollie: React to color cues while dribbling and stopping under control.
Alle starten mit Ball an einer Grundlini: Everyone starts with a ball on one baseline; the coach stands opposite. Beim Laufen kontrolliert dribbeln und be: Dribble under control while moving and stop firmly on the red cue.
Die Person, die den Coach zuerst erreich: The first player to reach the coach gives the cues in the next round.
Auf ein Signal beidbeinig und ausbalanci: Jump-stop on a signal and stay balanced.
Alle verteilen sich an der Grundlinie in: Players spread across a baseline in an athletic stance. When the coach raises an arm, move forward. When it drops, jump-stop in balance. Anyone who stops late or off-balance takes three steps back. Wait at the opposite baseline, then repeat on the way back.
Nach jedem Sprungstopp kurz in gebeugter: Hold a bent, stable stance briefly after every jump stop.
Grundform ohne Ball; Variante mit Basket: Basic form without a ball; basketballs for the variation
Beim Vorwärtslaufen dribbeln und den Bal: Dribble while moving forward and pick up the ball on the jump stop.
Nach dem Pass schneiden und den freien A: Cut after passing and recognize the open finish.
Eine Reihe an der Freiwurflinie mit Bäll: Form one line with balls at the top of the key and another on the wing. The coach defends the ball carrier. The ball carrier passes to the wing and cuts to the basket. If the cut is open, the wing player passes back; if the coach denies the cut, the wing player drives for a lay-up.
Scharf passen und nach dem Pass sofort z: Pass sharply and cut to the basket right away; look for the ball on the cut.
Mit Pässen freie Wege zum Zielkegel scha: Create open passing lanes to reach the target cone.
Ein rechteckiges Spielfeld oder ein Halb: Mark a rectangular area or half court with one target cone at each end. Two teams start in the middle, one with the ball. Advance by passing and knock down your assigned cone with a pass. If defenders steal or deflect a pass, possession changes. The coach may be used as an outlet; defenders may not guard the target cones.
Ohne Ball freilaufen; Passfinten und Piv: Move to get open without the ball; use pass fakes and pivots to create passing lanes.
Rechteckiges Spielfeld oder Halbfeld: Rectangular playing area or half court
1 Spiel bis zur Zielpunktzahl oder Zeitg: 1 game to a target score or time limit
Basketball, zwei Zielkegel und gegebenen: Basketball, two target cones and optional boundary markers
Vor einem Pass zwei bis drei Dribblings: Allow two or three dribbles before a pass.
Nach dem Ballgewinn im 2 gegen 2 schnell: Switch quickly between offense and defense after the ball contest in two-on-two play.
Alle stehen paarweise nummeriert an der: Number players in pairs along the baseline; matching numbers are teammates. The coach throws the ball onto the court and calls two numbers. The four called players contest the ball. The team that gains possession attacks while the other defends for one possession and one shot. Then call other numbers.
4+ pro Gruppe; vier pro Spielzug: 4+ in the group; four per possession
Als Fünferteam ohne Dribbling durch Päss: Advance to the opposite basket by passing in a team of five without dribbling, then score.
Fünferteams passen den Ball ohne Dribbli: Teams of five pass the ball to the opposite basket without dribbling and take a shot there. In the race, the first team to reach that basket without the ball touching the floor and make a shot wins.
Von einem Korb zum anderen: From one basket to the other
Basketball pro Team und zwei Körbe: One basketball per team and two baskets
Auf ein Nummernsignal reagieren, zum Kor: React to a number cue, run to the basket and finish.
Zwei Gruppen sitzen an der Mittellinie,: Two groups sit at midcourt, each facing a different basket. Give every player a number. When the coach calls a number, the matching players from both groups run to their basket and try to score; multiple attempts are allowed. The first player back earns a point for the group.
Mehrere Nummern gleichzeitig rufen; bei: Call several numbers at once; on the 'fire' cue, everyone runs.
Den Passfang mit Blickkontakt und klar g: Prepare to receive a pass with eye contact and clearly presented hands.
Vier oder fünf Personen bilden eine Grup: Work in groups of four or five. Everyone except one player dribbles a ball on the spot. The player without a ball shows their hands, calls a teammate's name and receives a bounce or chest pass. They pass back and move to the next player; change the receiving role on the coach's cue.
Vor dem Pass Blickkontakt aufnehmen und: Make eye contact before the pass and show hands as a catching target.
Für alle außer der fangenden Person je e: One basketball for everyone except the receiver
Boden- und Brustpässe gezielt durch ein: Aim bounce and chest passes through a marked gate.
Paare starten mit je einem Ball an der G: Pairs start on the baseline with one ball each. Set up several cone gates on a half or full court, at least one gate per pair. Vor dem Pass Blickkontakt aufnehmen; der: Make eye contact before passing; the receiver shows hands as a target.
Halb- oder Ganzfeld mit mindestens einem: Half or full court with at least one cone gate per pair
Ein Basketball pro Paar und Kegel für di: One basketball per pair and cones for gates
Brust- und Bodenpässe im Paar kontrollie: Pass and receive chest and bounce passes with a partner under control.
Zu zweit gegenüberstehen und sich den Ba: Face a partner and pass the ball back and forth, alternating two-handed chest passes and bounce passes. Catch each return pass and change the pass type.
Seitliche, seitlich aufsetzende und beid: Add side passes, side bounce passes and two-handed overhead passes.
Seitlich in Verteidigungshaltung verschi: Slide laterally in a defensive stance to close the passing lane.
Paare stellen zwei Kegel mit 6–8 ft Abst: Pairs place two cones 6–8 ft apart as a gate. One player defends between them in a low stance; the other rolls a ball through the gate. The defender slides laterally to stop it. Swap roles after one or two minutes.
Brust und Blick oben halten, zügig die R: Keep chest and eyes up, change direction quickly and push off the back foot.
Ein Basketball und zwei Kegel pro Paar: One basketball and two cones per pair
Statt des gerollten Balls dribbelt der A: Instead of rolling the ball, the attacker dribbles through the gate; the defender slides to cut off the drive.
Das Halbfeld in zwei Seiten teilen. Je S: Split the half court into two sides. On each side, two attackers and two defenders start at the wing and corner, with a coach at the elbow. An attacker passes to the coach and cuts to the basket; the coach passes to that player or their teammate. If no pass comes back, the cutter returns beyond the three-point line. Passing and cutting continue until a score or the coach calls 'Live' for 2-on-2. After a score or stop, defenders become attackers, two new defenders enter, and the coach restarts on the other side.
Verteidigerposition lesen und vor dem Cu: Read the defender and fake before cutting; use the coach as an outlet if the attack stalls.
Halbfeld, zwei Seiten: Half court, split into two sides
4 pro Feldseite plus Coach: Four per court side plus coach
Paare bilden: Eine Person verteidigt mit: Work in pairs. The defender starts with the ball, passes to the attacker and closes out. If there is space, the attacker shoots; against a tight closeout, they attack with one or two dribbles for a pull-up or layup. If the defender cuts off the first drive, the attacker changes direction with a crossover or another move. Swap roles after three or four actions.
Ein Basketball pro Paar und Korb: One basketball per pair and a basket
Den Pass in Bewegung fangen und den Clos: Catch the pass on the move and attack the closeout.
Drei Viererteams bilden. Ein Team starte: Form three teams of four. One team starts with the ball at midcourt and the other two defend a basket each. If the attackers score, they take the ball and attack the opposite basket. If defenders stop them, those defenders gain possession and attack the opposite basket. Play to three points. Original constraints include double points for a score within seven seconds, a win after three straight defensive stops, or allowing attackers to switch baskets after crossing midcourt.

Für einen defensiven Stop einen Punkt ve: Award one point for a defensive stop.
Dreierteams bilden. Ein Team startet mit: Form teams of three. One starts with the ball at midcourt and another defends at each basket. The team with the ball attacks one basket. Paare mit Ball an verschiedenen Position: Number pairs with a ball at different points around the three-point line. Um die Dreierlinie und ein Korb: Around the three-point line and one basket
Drei Angreifer stehen außerhalb der Drei: Start three attackers outside the arc and two defenders in the key. One defender passes to an attacker to begin live 3-on-2 at one basket. Einem Angreifer einen Cut mit Rückkehr h: Allow one attacker to cut and return beyond the arc, or limit ball holding time to one second.
Dreierteams an mehreren Körben bilden un: Create teams of three at several baskets and play live 3-on-3 without dribbling. Inbound after a score or turnover. The offense has 30 seconds to shoot. Bälle verschiedener Größen und Gewichte: Throw balls of different sizes and weights at targets from different heights and distances, such as tennis balls, mini basketballs, volleyballs or soccer balls into containers, marked circles or baskets. Change target height and distance for further rounds.
Bälle verschiedener Größen und Gewichte;: Balls of different sizes and weights; containers, circles or baskets as targets
Entfernung und Zielhöhe verändern; mit h: Vary distance and target height; use a higher target to encourage an upward throw.

Empfänger zeigen Blickkontakt und Hände;: Receivers show eye contact and their hands; the passer quickly identifies the open or ready target.

Freie Fläche für einen V-Parcours mit fü: Open space for a V-shaped course of five cones

4 pro Gruppe; weitere Spielende rotieren: Four per group; additional players rotate in

Hände als Passziel zeigen, in Triple-Thr: Show hands as a target, catch in triple threat and pass firmly; the cutter makes a hard basket cut with a hand up.

Den langen Pass aus der Bewegung präzise: Make the long pass accurately to the target while moving.
Ganzfeld: Grundlinie, Zielhütchen am geg: Full court: baseline, target cone on the opposite wing and starting basket

That player closes out to the ball, stays low in a defensive stance, calls 'ball' and traces the ball with the ball-side hand for three seconds. The ball handler then passes across, follows the pass and performs the next closeout. Keep rotating this way for two one-minute rounds.
Freie Fläche etwas breiter als die Zone: An area a little wider than the lane per group of three
Alle Kinder stehen ohne Ball in einer Re: Line up without a ball. The coach first demonstrates a right-handed lay-up: right step, left step, take off from the left foot and extend the right arm to simulate the shot. Each player then moves through one at a time, says 'one, two' aloud and high-fives the coach's raised hand with the right hand while jumping. Keep the line moving. After three minutes switch sides: left arm, take off from the right foot and reverse the footwork; practise for another three minutes.
Freie Laufbahn für eine Reihe; kein Korb: Open lane for a line of players; no basket required
Kein Ball; Coach als High-Five-Ziel: No ball; coach as the high-five target
Alle Kinder stellen sich ohne Ball an de: Line up without a ball on the baseline. The coach selects the first foot and calls the rhythm 'one, two, jump'. Turn at the far end and come back using the opposite foot and hand. Go down and back twice.
Basketballfeld von Grundlinie zu Grundli: Basketball court from baseline to baseline
Die Kinder verteilen sich mit Blick zum: Spread out facing the coach. On 'Defense!' players briefly slap the floor, drop into a low defensive stance and call 'I love it!'. Repeat the call and response five times while staying in stance. Then the coach points left or right and players slide in that direction. On a shot fake they raise one hand to contest. Run two sets of five stance calls; optionally work in groups of three or four and rotate the player giving cues.
Die Kinder bilden Paare an der Seitenlin: Form pairs on the sideline; the first child in each pair has a ball. Put cones of different colours in the middle of the court. To start, the coach shows a number. Player one touches exactly that many cones without touching the same colour twice in a row, dribbles to the basket and takes one shot. A make scores three points and touching the rim scores one. Player two then takes the ball, touches the same sequence of cones and takes one shot. Keep a running score for each pair across rounds; then call a new number or colour sequence.

1 Basketball pro Paar, verschiedenfarbig: One basketball per pair, different-coloured cones and a basket
Paare bewegen sich über das Feld: Das vo: Pairs move around the court: the child in front dribbles one ball; the child behind carries a hoop and directs the way to an open spot. As a variation, spin the hoop between them and have the child without the ball catch it before it falls.

1 Basketball und 1 Reifen pro Paar: One basketball and one hoop per pair
Alle Kinder bewegen sich zunächst frei ü: All children move freely around the court; every third child has a ball and dribbles. On 'together', form groups of three: the dribbler takes the middle position, one child without a ball leads and the other follows. On 'free', separate and move individually again. During this phase a child without a ball may request the ball with open catching hands; the dribbler passes it. As a variation, the middle child calls 'switch' to reverse direction or 'stop' to form a triangle and pass the ball.

Alle Kinder bewegen sich frei über das F: Everyone moves freely around the court; half the children each dribble a ball. On a cue, each child without a ball selects a dribbler, moves close and follows for three to five seconds without contact. Then they increase the distance, keep eye contact and wave from afar. After another three to five seconds they close the distance again. On 'switch', the players exchange roles and move freely again. Variations: stay behind the dribbler, stay in front, or try to steal the ball without fouling on 'defense'.
Paare; die Hälfte der Gruppe mit Ball: Pairs; half the group with a ball

One team has the 'power': its player may attack the basket and shoot at any time. The other reacts, follows and also tries to score. The first to score three points wins the power for their team in the next round. Vary the pass type and distance.
Zwei Viererteams bilden: eines verteidig: Make two teams of four, one on offense and one on defense. All four offensive players start on the perimeter, with no post player. They make five passes while the other team defends. Only after the fifth pass is the ball live and the offense may attack the basket. Switch offense and defense after every possession. Play for six minutes. For harder variations, count only baskets following a screen or a drive and kick-out pass.
Ein Halbfeld mit Korb; Angriff zunächst: One half-court and basket; offense starts on the perimeter
Zwei Dreierteams spielen an einem Korb g: Two teams of three play at one basket; with four or more teams, use both baskets. The coach starts with the ball on the wing. An offensive guard on the ball-side low block sets a cross-screen through the lane for a post player to move to the ball side. A third offensive player near the free-throw line then screens for the first guard to come up to the top. Play live three-on-three after that action. On each change of possession, take the ball back to the top of the arc before attacking again. The offense keeps the ball after a basket. Continue without a check ball and play to three made baskets.
6 pro Spiel; zwei Dreierteams und Coach: Six per game; two teams of three and a coach
Halbfeld mit Flügel, Zone, Freiwurflinie: Half-court with wing, lane, free-throw line and basket
1 Basketball und 1 Korb pro Spiel: One basketball and one basket per game
Dreiergruppen bilden und jeder Gruppe ei: Assign a number to each team of three and line everyone up on the baseline. The coach throws one ball onto the court and calls two numbers. Those six players sprint for it. The team that secures the ball attacks; the other defends. Each possession ends after one shot. Call the numbers evenly across rounds and play to five points.
Drei Reihen an einer Grundlinie aufstell: Set up three lines on one baseline: the middle line has balls and the other two are on the wings. Two defenders start at the far basket. The first player in each line attacks three-on-two, with only one shot allowed. Whoever shoots or turns the ball over runs back alone to defend the starting basket. The other two attackers stay at the far basket as the next defenders. The original two defenders take the ball back for a two-on-one attack. Then the next three players start and the others join the backs of the lines. Continue for four minutes.
Mindestens 5 gleichzeitig; weitere Kinde: At least five active; others in three lines
Ganzfeld mit zwei Körben und drei Startr: Full court with two baskets and three starting lines
Basketbälle in der mittleren Startreihe,: Basketballs in the middle starting line and two baskets
Zwei Dreierteams spielen an einem Korb;: Two teams of three play at one basket; use both baskets if there are four or more teams. A guard with the ball starts at the top of the arc and passes to a teammate at the elbow. The third attacker is on the same-side wing. The two guards may then work together through cuts and screens, and play becomes live three-on-three after the opening pass. After each change of possession, bring the ball back to the top. The offense keeps the ball after a basket. Continue without a check ball and play to three made baskets.
6 pro Spiel; zwei Dreierteams: Six per game; two teams of three
Halbfeld mit Flügel, Freiwurflinien-Elle: Half-court with wing, elbow and basket
Zwei Angreifende und ein Verteidiger ste: Two attackers and one defender begin in a tight group, each with one hand on the same ball. Play starts when one attacker takes the ball. The offense may not dribble: the two attackers immediately spread out, pass and cut into open space to create a shot. Switch roles after three or four consecutive possessions. For a harder version, restrict play to one side of the court.
3 pro Gruppe; 2 Angreifende, 1 Verteidig: Three per group: two attackers and one defender
Ein Korb mit freiem Halbfeld; optional a: One basket and open half-court; optionally limited to one side
Zwei Dreierteams beginnen an einem Korb;: Two teams of three start at one basket; use both baskets with four or more teams. Every offensive possession must begin with a down screen: an off-ball attacker screens for a teammate. Then play live three-on-three. On a change of possession, take the ball back to the top of the arc before attacking again. After a basket, the offense keeps the ball. Continue without a check ball and play to three made baskets.

Two teams of three start at one basket; use both baskets with four or more teams. Every offensive possession begins with a pick-and-roll: an attacker sets an on-ball screen and then moves towards the basket. Play live three-on-three after that action. After a change of possession, take the ball back to the top of the arc before attacking again. The offense keeps the ball after a basket. Continue without a check ball and play to three made baskets.
An jedem Flügel eine Reihe bilden; ein K: Make a line on each wing, with one player holding the ball at the top of the arc. That player passes to a wing and cuts to the basket, raising a hand for a possible return pass. The player on the wing without the ball fills the top. The cutter leaves the drill and joins the back of the line on the wing that just filled the top. The ball-side wing passes to the new player at the top, who reverses the ball to the other wing and cuts. Repeat this sequence; only players at the top cut. Practise for two minutes.
Mindestens 3; zwei Flügelreihen und eine: At least three: two wing lines and one player at the top
Halbfeld mit beiden Flügeln, Dreipunktbo: Half-court with both wings, top of arc and basket
Zwei Fünferteams spielen fünf gegen fünf: Two teams of five play full-court five-on-five. Each game lasts four minutes; then another game can start with the same or reshuffled teams. When a specific coaching point arises, the coach briefly stops play, explains the situation and resumes the game.
10 gleichzeitig; zwei Fünferteams: Ten at once; two teams of five
Dreierteams bilden. Zwei Teams beginnen: Form teams of three. Two teams start playing live three-on-three in the half-court; use both baskets if there are four or more teams. After every change of possession, return the ball to the top of the arc before attacking. If the offense scores, that team becomes the defense and a new offensive team enters. If the defense gets a stop, it earns one point and stays on defense while a new offense enters. Continue without a check ball until a team reaches four points.
6 gleichzeitig; weitere Dreierteams zum: Six active; additional teams of three rotate in
Halbfeld mit Dreipunktbogen und Korb; be: Half-court with arc and basket; use two baskets with four teams
An möglichst vielen Körben je ein angrei: At as many baskets as possible, place one attacker and one defender on a wing. A passer with the ball stands on the opposite wing and a second attacker starts at the top of the arc as the screener. The screener sets an off-ball screen for the wing attacker but may not receive the ball or shoot. The wing attacker has five seconds to use the screen, after which play becomes live one-on-one. After each attack, the attacker becomes the defender, a new player comes in on offense and the screener joins the line. Practise for five minutes. Award one point for an open shot, two for a made basket and one for a successful screen leading to a shot. For a progression, defend the screener too and play two-on-two; defenders may not switch.
4 aktiv pro Korb: Angreifer, Verteidiger: Four active per basket: attacker, defender, screener and passer
Auf dem Halbfeld mit vier äußeren Hütche: Use four outside cones to make a diamond in a half-court, plus one cone in the center. Form a line at each outside cone; the first line has at least two players and one ball. The first player dribbles to the center, makes a two-foot jump stop, forward pivots to face the next line and throws an overhead pass. They follow the pass and join the back of that line. The receiver dribbles to the center and repeats. Play four one-minute rounds, changing pivots after each: forward left, forward right, reverse left, reverse right.
5 Hütchen und 1 Basketball pro Raute: Five cones and one basketball per diamond
Je zwei Kinder mit einem Ball an einen K: Pair up with one ball at a basket, standing only a few feet away. The shooter holds the ball in the dominant hand in front of the body, elbow under the ball and palm facing up. Extend knees and shooting arm together, snap the wrist and hold the follow-through until the ball goes in or misses. The partner retrieves and returns the ball for the next attempt. Switch roles after a series; complete two sets of ten shots.
1 Basketball und 1 Korb pro Paar: One basketball and one basket per pair
Paare mit je einem Ball an verschiedenen: Set pairs with one ball at different spots around the three-point arc and number each pair. The defender stands just inside the arc facing the basket. The attacker stands behind, touching the defender's back with the ball. The coach stands in the lane and calls a pair's number. The attacker takes the ball off the defender's back and attacks; the defender must touch the floor with both hands before defending. If the coach stays out of the way, drive for a layup; if the coach steps forward, stop for a shot. Swap offense and defense after every possession, made or missed. Play to three points.
Ein Korb mit mehreren Startpunkten am Dr: One basket with several starting spots on the arc; coach in the lane
1 Basketball pro Paar und 1 Korb: One basketball per pair and one basket
Dreiergruppen mit je zwei Bällen auf Kör: Split into groups of three with two balls at each basket and choose the shooting spots and shot type. On the signal, the first player shoots, followed shortly by the second. Both follow their own shot, rebound and pass to the open teammate. After passing, move to a new open shooting spot and be ready for the next pass. Change basket, shot type or side of the basket after two minutes; play three two-minute rounds.
2 Basketbälle und 1 Korb pro Dreiergrupp: Two basketballs and one basket per group of three
Mehrere möglichst gleich große Teams an: Make several roughly even teams in lines on the baseline, with a ball for the first player in each line. Choose a finish line, such as half-court or the far baseline. On the signal, the first players dribble to it, make a two-foot jump stop, pick up the ball and backpedal to their line. They high-five the next player and hand over the ball so that player starts. The first round ends when everyone has gone three times. Play a second round with the other dribbling hand.
Grundlinie und festgelegte Ziellinie; ei: Baseline and chosen finish line; one lane per team
Alle aktiven Kinder nehmen je einen Bask: Every active player takes a basketball and finds open space on the court with room around them. Dribble with the right hand for five seconds, then the left for five seconds. For the next five seconds, dribble freely and creatively. Repeat this 15-second sequence without changing stations until one minute has passed.
Beliebig viele; jede aktive Person mit e: Any number; each active player has a ball
Freie, verteilte Plätze auf dem Spielfel: Open, spaced-out spots on the court
Paare mit je einem Ball suchen eine frei: Pairs take one ball and find an open spot on the court, facing each other. One player shoots the ball to the partner using shooting form: bent knees, shooting arm under the ball, extend legs and arm together, then snap the wrist and hold the follow-through. The partner catches and shoots it back in the same way. Play two rounds of five shots per player. As a variation, both stand on a line and shoot the ball straight up so that it lands on the line in front of them; the partner catches and repeats.
Freie Stelle auf dem Spielfeld, ohne Kor: Open spot on the court, no basket
Alle aktiven Kinder verteilen sich mit j: Each active player takes a ball and spreads out in a designated practice area. With arms extended in front of the waist, tap the ball quickly from hand to hand using only the fingertips, as if it were too hot to hold. Keep tapping while moving the ball above the head, in front of the face and back to the waist. Complete two 30-second rounds.
Mit einem Basketball wenige Schritte vor: Stand a short distance from a wall with a basketball and choose or mark a target on it. On each chest pass, step toward the target with the lead foot, extend both arms and snap the thumbs down. Let the ball bounce once after it hits the wall, catch it under control and pass again. Complete three sets of ten passes.
Einzeln an einer freien Wandstelle; Ball: Individually at an open wall space; a ball may be shared
Wandfläche mit Zielmarkierung und kurzer: Wall with a target and a short passing distance
Paare bilden und innerhalb des Dreipunkt: Make pairs and find separate starting spots inside the three-point arc. One player attacks and the other defends, starting a few steps away. The defender passes to the attacker and then applies pressure. At first the attacker may not dribble; they pivot to make room for a shot or layup. Switch roles after a shot or a defensive steal. After a few rounds, allow one dribble before pivoting. Practise for six minutes.
Paare; je 1 Angriff und 1 Verteidigung: Pairs; one attacker and one defender each
Freie Startplätze innerhalb des Dreipunk: Separate starts inside the arc with access to a basket
1 Basketball pro Paar und ein Korb: One basketball per pair and a basket
Guards nach Spielstärke zu Paaren ordnen: Pair guards by ability and make a high line on each wing near half-court. Pair post players too, forming one line on each baseline at the lane line. On one side, the first two guards and first two posts enter, with one attacker and one defender at each position. On the ball-handling guard's signal, the attacking post comes to set a side ball screen. The four play exactly one two-on-two possession from the screen. The other side starts immediately afterward. Then partners switch sides and offensive and defensive roles. Repeat for ten minutes; the coach may specify how to defend the screen.
Mindestens 8 für beide Seiten; je 4 glei: At least eight for both sides; four active at a time
Zwei Flügelstarts nahe der Mittellinie,: Two wing starts near half-court, post lines at both baseline lane lines, one basket
Basketball für den jeweiligen angreifend: Basketball for the attacking guard and one basket
Alle Kinder starten mit je einem Ball in: All players line up inside the half-court on one side of the basket, each with a ball. A chair or cone represents the screener; the coach defends that position. In turn, a player dribbles toward the screen, calls for it and uses it as if their own defender had gone over the screen and been caught. The coach shows one of three reactions: hedge out, drop back or defend between the two positions. The ball-handler reads the response and takes the appropriate shot. Complete five repetitions per player on each side of the basket, then switch sides.
Ein Kind und ein Coach aktiv; übrige war: One player and one coach active; others wait with balls
Halbfeld mit seitlicher Blockposition un: Half-court with a side screen position and basket; both sides
1 Basketball pro Kind, 1 Stuhl oder Hütc: One basketball per player, one chair or cone as screen, one basket
5 Wiederholungen pro Kind und Seite: Five repetitions per player on each side
Dreierteams bilden und an einem Korb dre: Make teams of three and play three-on-three at one basket; use both baskets if there are four or more teams. The first attack starts with a baseline drive. One defender helps to stop the ball and the third defender helps that helper. The ball-handler kicks the ball back out, and only then is play live. After every change of possession, return the ball to the top of the arc before attacking again. The offense keeps the ball after a basket; continue quickly without a check. Practise for six minutes.
Halbfeld mit Grundlinie, Dreipunktbogens: Half-court with baseline, top of the arc and basket
Paare bilden; je zwei Kinder stehen sich: Make pairs facing each other with one ball. A bounce-passes to B; B catches and returns a two-handed chest pass. Repeat after each return and later swap passing roles. In further rounds, both partners may exchange chest, bounce, side or overhead passes. Catch the ball under control before every pass.
Freier Platz für gegenüberstehende Paare: Open space for pairs facing each other
Alle Kinder verteilen sich auf die marki: Spread all players along the marked court lines. First move only along sidelines, baselines and circles: walk, run, jump or dribble a ball. Then designate some players as taggers. In the Pac-Man variation, both taggers and other players may move only on lines while taggers try to touch them. Change taggers after a round and play again with the line rule.
Basketbälle nur für die Dribbelvariante: Basketballs only for the dribbling variation
Paare mit je einem Ball bilden und einan: Make pairs with one ball each and face each other in open half-court space. A dribbles forward while B dribbles backward, keeping distance. On alternating verbal and visual coach signals, both reverse direction. Swap leader roles after a run. To progress, A chooses forward, backward or sideways movement and B moves in the opposite direction. Both keep dribbling and look up to see the signal.
Paare bilden; beide haben einen Ball und: Make pairs; each partner has a ball and faces the other about one metre apart. A leads dribble moves while B mirrors them and maintains eye contact. While stationary, try right- and left-hand dribbles, a crossover in front or two high and two low dribbles. Swap the leader after a sequence. Once both control the pattern, they can mirror each other while moving through open space without crossing other pairs.
Redaktionelle Übungsform nach „Dribble l: Editorial practice based on “Dribble lines”: Each player takes a ball and starts spaced out along a court line. Everyone dribbles on the lines. When two players meet, both slow under control, change dribbling hand and reverse along their line. Look up and leave space at intersections; start another round from a different line.
Zwei Reihen mit Abstand einander gegenüb: Set up two facing lines with space between them; A starts with the ball. The first player in the opposite line moves toward the ball. A leads the receiver with a pass; the receiver keeps moving until the catch, then lands in a two-foot jump stop. A moves to the opposite line. The receiver passes to the next player from the first line, who moves toward the ball. Continue alternating between lines; after each pass join the back of the other line.
Freier Platz für zwei gegenüberstehende: Open space for two facing lines
Redaktionelle Übungsform: Paare stehen s: Editorial practice: Partners face each other in two parallel lanes with one ball. Both slide sideways about three steps in a defensive stance without crossing their feet. A stops in balance and chest-passes to B; B catches, both slide back the other way and B passes back. Switch the starting side after five passes. The ball stays with the ball handler during each slide.
Zwei freie parallele Bahnen pro Paar: Two clear parallel lanes per pair
Zu zweit an einem Korb mit einem Ball ar: Work in pairs at one basket with one ball. The shooter stands inside the three-point line facing the basket and ready to catch; the partner starts under the basket with the ball. The partner passes. On the catch, the shooter steps into the shot with a one-two foot sequence and shoots. The passer rebounds and passes again. After ten makes, swap roles and repeat.
Ein Korb; Wurfposition innerhalb der Dre: One basket; shooting spot inside the three-point line
Redaktionelle Übungsform nach „Closeout: Editorial practice based on “Closeout 1 on 1”: A passer starts with the ball at the top of the arc, an attacker stands on the wing and a defender begins at the free-throw line. The passer feeds the wing. The defender closes out under control, shortens the steps and stays between attacker and basket. On the catch, the attacker has at most three dribbles to finish. After a shot or stop, recover the ball; defender becomes passer, passer becomes wing attacker, attacker joins the back and the next player defends.
Halbfeld mit Korb; Passgeber oben, Angri: Half court with basket; passer at top, attacker on wing, defender at free-throw line
Redaktionelle Kontrollserie: Alle stehen: Editorial control series: Everyone stands facing the coach with one ball each and enough space. With the right hand, dribble side to side in place for 15 seconds low, 15 seconds at mid height and 15 seconds higher. Repeat the sequence with the left hand; that makes one set. Complete three sets, briefly resetting between them. Keep the ball controlled and lift the eyes away from it when possible.
Freier Standplatz mit Abstand pro Person: Clear stationary spot with space for each player
Passgeber an der Dreipunktbogenspitze, A: Set a passer at the top of the arc, attacker on the wing and defender at the free-throw line. The pass to the wing triggers the closeout: the defender runs out, shortens the final steps and raises a hand. Once the attacker catches, they have at most three dribbles to attack the basket. The defender slides laterally to cut off the path. After a shot or stop, defender becomes passer, passer becomes attacker, attacker joins the line and the next player defends.
Dreiergruppen mit einem Ball am Korb bil: Form groups of three with one ball near a basket: two attackers stand near each other, and a defender guards the off-ball player from help position. A passes to B; the defender closes out to B and calls “ball”. B returns the pass to A; the defender jumps back into help. A shoots. On the shot, the defender locates and tags their own player, then pursues the ball for the rebound. Secure the ball and rotate the three roles for the next repetition.
Dreiergruppen; 1 Ball pro Gruppe: Groups of three; one ball per group
Zwei Reihen an gegenüberliegenden Flügel: Make two lines on opposite wings; the first player in one line has the ball. They drive along the baseline toward the basket with intent to score. At the same time, the first player on the opposite wing drops into the open corner. Near the basket, the driver passes to the corner; the receiver catches ready to shoot and shoots. Both rebound and switch wing lines. Continue to eight makes, then reverse the attacking side.
Halbfeld mit Korb; je eine Reihe an beid: Half court with basket; one line on each wing
Alle stehen in einer Reihe an der Grundl: Line up on the baseline where it meets the lane line. The first player sprints to the near free-throw-line elbow and decelerates into a controlled closeout. From there, they slide defensively across the lane to the opposite elbow. Then they backpedal to the baseline and rejoin the back of the line. The next player begins as soon as the previous player reaches the first elbow. Work for two minutes, reverse directions and repeat for two minutes.
Zone eines Halbfelds mit Grundlinie und: Half-court lane with baseline and both free-throw-line elbows
Redaktionelle Übungsform: Drei Angreifer: Editorial practice: Three attackers and three matched defenders play at one basket. Offense starts at the top of the arc with a pass to a wing. On every pass, all defenders move with the ball: the on-ball defender stops the ball, while the two off-ball defenders jump to a position between their player and the ball and keep both in view. After three passes, offense may drive to score; after a shot or turnover, teams swap attack and defense. Match up again before restarting.
Redaktionelle Übungsform: Ballführer am: Editorial practice: Set a ball handler on the wing, a screener beside the on-ball defender and the coach as the ball handler’s defender. The screener sets a stationary screen; the handler dribbles tightly past it and reads the coach. If the defender goes over, the handler attacks the basket or takes a short shot; if the defender goes under, the handler stops for an open outside shot. After the finish, the pair retrieves the ball, swaps handler and screener roles and repeats from the other side.
Halbfeld mit Korb; Block am Flügel: Half court with basket; wing ball screen
Redaktionelle Übungsform: Drei gegen dre: Editorial practice: Play three on three across two baskets. One team starts on offense in the half court; before each shot, one attacker is assigned to pursue the offensive rebound and one stays above the lane as transition safety. After the shot, everyone contests the ball. If defense rebounds or wins possession, it immediately attacks the opposite basket; the original attackers first stop the ball and then protect the basket. After the finish at the far basket or another turnover, stop, reassign roles and rebounding tasks, and start a new possession.
Zu zweit an einem Korb mit einem Ball ar: Work in pairs at one basket with one ball. The shooter stands inside the three-point line facing the basket and ready to catch; the partner starts under the basket with the ball. The partner passes. On the catch, the shooter plants the feet in a one-two sequence and shoots. The passer rebounds and passes again. After ten makes, swap roles and repeat.
4,5 Minuten (3 Serien je Hand mit je 3 ×: 4.5 minutes (3 sets per hand, each with 3 × 15 seconds)
Redaktionelle Übungsform: Drei Angreifer: Editorial practice: Three attackers occupy the top of the arc and both wings; three matched defenders set up. The ball starts at the top with a pass to a wing. On every pass, all defenders move with the ball: the on-ball defender stops the ball, while the two off-ball defenders jump to a position between their player and the ball and keep both in view. After three passes, offense may drive or shoot. After a shot or turnover, teams swap attack and defense. Match up again before restarting.
Redaktionelle Übungsform: Drei gegen dre: Editorial practice: Play three on three across two baskets. One team starts on offense in the half court; before each shot, one attacker is assigned to pursue the offensive rebound and one stays above the lane as transition safety. After the shot, everyone contests the ball. If offense rebounds, it continues at the same basket. If defense rebounds or wins possession, it immediately attacks the opposite basket; the original attackers first stop the ball and then protect the basket. After the finish at the far basket, stop, reassign roles and rebounding tasks, and start a new possession.
